findings.title: Removed the .title float rule from the header without replacement
findings.body: The diff deletes the `.title { float: left; }` rule inside `.d-header`. Nothing in the PR restores positioning for the title element, and the PR does not mention the removal. The `.contents` container is switched from block flow to flexbox in the same hunk, so the title becomes a content-sized flex item instead of a floated block. If the title/logo markup depends on that float, the left side of the header will shift. The removal needs to be justified or replaced with an explicit flex rule, and checked visually.

findings.title: float: right on the small-action button is ignored now that .small-action is a flex container
findings.body: `.small-action` now gets `@include flexbox()` (added in this PR), and the `button` inside it still relies on `float: right`. Floats do not apply to flex items, so the button is no longer pushed to the right edge. Its position becomes the next slot after `.small-action-desc`, which has no flex-grow. For short messages the button will sit right next to the text instead of at the right side of the notice. Either the button needs `margin-left: auto` or similar, or the float should be dropped as intentional. As written, the rendering change is unaddressed.

findings.title: Bullet badge margin-top rule removed from the extra-info wrapper with no replacement
findings.body: The `&.bullet { margin-top: 5px; }` rule under `.extra-info-wrapper .badge-wrapper` is deleted. The bullet badge in this area was previously offset by that margin. The same PR changes the bullet badge's display model (inline-flex with baseline alignment in badges.css.scss), so vertical alignment of the bullet is changed in two places at once with no stated intent and no replacement offset. This is likely to misalign the bullet relative to the category text.

findings.title: Unrelated spacing changes in .small-action-desc and its children
findings.body: Beyond adding flexbox, the PR changes `.small-action-desc` padding from `0.5em 0 0.5em 4em` to `0 1.5%`, drops `margin-top: 5px`, changes the `.custom-message p` margin from `5px 0` to `0`, and removes `padding-top: 4px` from `> p`. None of these follow from switching to flexbox, and the PR gives no reason for them. They change the visible spacing of every small-action notice and should be split out or justified.

findings.title: order(2) and line-height on .extra-info-wrapper are unexplained and may be no-ops
findings.body: `order` only affects flex or grid items. Nothing in this change makes the parent of `.extra-info-wrapper` a flex container, so `@include order(2)` on line 30 may have no effect. The added `line-height: 1.5` on line 32 applies to every descendant of the wrapper and changes line box heights in the topic title area, which is not mentioned. Both should be confirmed against the markup or removed.

findings.title: align-items mixin emits a nonexistent -ms-align-items property
findings.body: `-ms-align-items` is not a real CSS property. No browser ever supported it, and the correct IE10 prefixed property (`-ms-flex-align`) is already emitted on line 120. The declaration is dead output that will be silently dropped, and it suggests the mixin was not written against real property names. It should be removed.

findings.title: PR description is a placeholder and the performance claim is unsupported
findings.body: The description reads only 'Test 5', and the title says the change optimizes header layout performance. The PR contains no measurement, benchmark, or before/after evidence. Switching from floats to flexbox is a layout-model change, not a performance optimization by itself. The diff also changes header, topic title, small-action notices, and badges, and gives no visual verification. The description should explain the purpose, the expected visual outcome, and how it was checked, and the title should match what the change actually does.
